Two sites, one Bun workspace

Architecting a project for the agent era

When coding agents write most of the code, the way you structure a project matters more than ever. Here is how I set up RabtX Starter and Grid, piece by piece, and why each piece is there.

UI/UX design in the AI era: tips, tricks and a cheat sheet

An AI model can draw a screen in ten seconds now. That is the problem. When anyone can generate a dashboard, the dashboard stops being the work. The work is knowing which screen is right, and writing it down so the next one comes out right on its own.

Building Grid with the agents it runs
